aliases: Smart Energy Partners Guernsey County data center
status_detail: Guernsey County commissioners discussed a proposed data center on June 9, 2026; official minutes describe a potential property evaluation, closed-loop/minimal-water concepts, natural-gas/on-site power options, and next steps for Rich Stokey and Jason Miller. Commissioners later issued a June 16/17, 2026 opposition statement saying they would not support tax abatements or infrastructure assistance. DCD/WOUC reporting says the proposal is in very early stages and no location was disclosed.
notes: No MW, acreage, exact site, or formal application found. Included because official county minutes and press release show a real early-stage proposal and local-government response.

status_detail: MARA announced in November 2024 that it began developing a 150 MW greenfield data center operation in Findlay, Ohio, with 30 MW already available and intended full energization by year-end 2025. MARA's June 2026 Ohio Select Committee testimony lists its facility at Findlay in Hancock County among its Ohio operations.
notes: One Power SEC filing says a portion of the Findlay Megawatt Hub in Hancock County is leased to MARA under a 150 MW, 15-year contract. Status set construction because original announcement described greenfield development; current full energization not independently confirmed.
